detail: Reverse proxy serves a pixel-perfect copy of the ACME login page to the victim
Captured password in transit for alice@acme.example
Captured the one-time MFA code as the victim typed it
Relayed the captured credentials + MFA code to the real ACME server in real time
Stole the authenticated session cookie issued after MFA: ACME-SESSION-3eb3e1ece82...
Sent the stolen cookie to the attacker channel (simulated: Telegram bot)

attack_name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Web Session Cookie
detail: Authenticated as the victim using only the stolen cookie, bypassing password and MFA
